project.title: Proteomes of chromatin fractions derived from SU-DHL-5 cells
project.projectDescription: SU-DHL-5 cells display limited expression of the SUMO isopeptidase SENP6. In this experiment, the chromatin associated fraction of SU-DHL-5 cells was analysed by mass spectrometry. SU-DHL-5 cells were either stably transfected with an empty vector or with a SENP6 expression construct. Changes in protein levels were compared between these two cell lines in triplicate experiments.
project.sampleProcessingProtocol: Chromatin fractions were isolated from SU-DHL-5 control cells and from SU-DHL-5 cells that were stably transfected with a SENP6 expression plasmid. Proteomic analysis was performed in triplicate experiments using these chromatin fractions. More Details can be found in the associated publication: Schick et al.: Actionable genetic alterations of the SUMO isopeptidase SENP6 drive lymphomagenesis and genetic instability in diffuse large B-cell lymphoma (2021) Nat. Commun.
project.dataProcessingProtocol: All acquired raw files of mass spectra were analysed using MaxQuant Software (version 1.6.17.0) (Cox and Mann, 2008) and the implemented Andromeda database search engine (Cox et al., 2011). Fragmentation spectra were correlated with the Uniprot human database (v.2015/2017). To perform searches, tryptic digestion and default settings for mass tolerances of MS and MS/MS spectra were applied. False discovery rate (FDR) was set to 1%, minimal LFQ ratio count was set to 2 and FastLFQ option was enabled for relative label-free quantification of proteins. For the analysis, the match between run feature was used.
